svātana [cp. Sk. œvastana; Geiger, P.Gr. § 6, 54] relating to the morrow; dat. °--nāya for the following day Vin I.27; D I.125; J I.11; DhA I.314; IV.12.
svātivatta [su+ativatta] easily overcome Sn 785; Nd1 76.

sve (adv.) [cp. Sk. œvas] to--morrow Vin II.77; D I.108, 205; J I.32, 243; II.47; VvA 230; svedivasa DhA I.103. The diæretic form is suve, e. g. Pv IV.15; Mhvs 29, 17; and doubled suve suve day after day Dh 229; DhA III.329; J V.507.
